history.note: rule conflict: 7 of 9 secondaries use UK 'acknowledgement' (QC H2 blocks) so K8 cannot reach 6 secondaries; plan written and passes plan-check

plan.angle: The live results are signature pages: a Practical Law sample, employer PDFs from a village, a school and a university, a Scribd copy, a DocHub fill-and-sign file and a Paperform template. Each gives one employee one line to sign. None answers the question HR has a month later: who signed which version, who has not, and what happened when someone refused. This page wins by treating the acknowledgment as a record tied to a handbook version, shown in four situations searchers have: re-signing after a handbook update, a single policy signed on a phone, completion tracked across several stores, and a refusal documented with a witness.
tab_stories: Fenwick Dental Group publishes handbook version 2027.1 with a rewritten PTO section, and the form asks only the 49 of its 52 staff still on version 2026.2 to sign again, because the 3 newest hires signed 2027.1 at onboarding.
Corvid Freight sends its hands-free phone policy to drivers, who tick four policy statements on their phones before the signature box opens, and each signature is saved with the policy name and date.
Marigold Market tracks handbook signatures across 6 stores, Eastgate trails at 22 of 36, and its store manager gets a Slack message listing the 14 staff who have not signed.

At Brightwater Clinic an employee can choose to decline or ask a question instead of signing, the reason goes to HR, and when a refusal stands, the HR lead records it and a witness signs and dates the note.
openers: Write the statement in plain words
heading_shapes: Only staff on version 2026.2 sign again
Signature locked until all four boxes are ticked

claims_to_source: A sample acknowledgment states that the handbook is not a contract of employment, that employment is at will, and that policies may change; signed forms are kept in the employee's file
If an employee refuses to sign, a company representative can note the refusal on the form and sign and date it with a witness, and asking why the employee refuses can surface an outdated policy
An acknowledgment form names the employee, the handbook title, its version and its effective date
